title: The commuting square grows a ternary spatial address
kind: Exact semantic lift and all-ECA role-growth census
summary: The two paths around a commuting square and their XOR residual define a rule-independent recursive L/R/C lift. Depth-d words form a 3^d ternary address space with a forced algebraic quotient; 33 ECAs close within depth six and 107 saturate the maximum tested role growth.
takeaway: The commutator can be represented as a new coordinate rather than only measured: each added semantic dimension stores the two operation orders and their residual. A native autonomous higher-dimensional CA realization remains open.
